title: Chosen-compactification compact-support compositors and common-refinement change
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and use the ordinary small etale and pro-etale derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $f:X	o Y$ and $g:Y	o Z$ be quasi-compact scheme morphisms with compactifications $c,d,e$ of $f,g,fg$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $P^c_{h,A}=Rp_*j_!$ for the compactification-relative compact-support candidates [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Define the etale bounded-below compositor $P^c_{f,A}P^d_{g,A}\cong P^e_{fg,A}$ (functors composed left to right) by comparison from $c,d$ to the chosen compactifications of $f,g$, the canonical etale compositor, then comparison to $e$ [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. For compactifications $c,d$ of the same quasi-compact $f$ and $L\in D^+(X_{et},A)$, define the pro-etale common-refinement change from $P^c_f
u_X^*L$ to $P^d_f
u_X^*L$ to be the inverse of the proper-refinement comparison from $c\wedge d$ to $c$, followed by that from $c\wedge d$ to $d$ [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism]. Define the pro-etale compositor at $
u_X^*L$ by changing $c,d$ to the chosen compactifications, inserting the canonical compact-support site comparison for the intermediate etale object [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction], applying the canonical etale-origin compositor [thm-sf-comp-composition], and changing the composite compactification to $e$. All changes use the specified common-refinement construction. These are definitions of the existing canonical composites; no new coherence equation is asserted.

    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (c : Compactification f) (d : Compactification g) (e : Compactification (f ≫ g)) :
    Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ⋙
        Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d ≅
      Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e
